description: This file contains a test runner class for implicit subscription recovery in Orleans streaming, implementing test scenarios for event stream processing with transient and non-transient errors, and methods for checking stream counters.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscritionRecoverableStreamTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for conducting implicit subscription recovery streaming tests in Orleans, handling generation of streams, error scenarios, and validation of event counts.

methods.name: Recoverable100EventStreamsWithTransientErrors
methods.description: Runs a test scenario generating streams with transient errors and verifies the counters after processing.

methods.name: Recoverable100EventStreamsWith1NonTransientError
methods.description: Runs a test with a non-transient error in stream processing, verifying counters reflect the fault.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Verifies that the stream counters match expected values, optionally asserting correctness.
